cards.name: The Borg Queen
cards.oracle_text:
Artifact creatures you control get +2/+2.
Whenever The Borg Queen enters or attacks, target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a creature card. Assimilate that card. They put the rest on the bottom in a random order. (To assimilate a card, put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)

cards.name: Commander Spock
cards.oracle_text: Strange new worlds — Whenever Commander Spock enters or attacks, reveal the top card of your library. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is equal to or less than the number of differently named lands you control. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If that card is still on top of your library, draw a card.

cards.name: Jean-Luc Picard, Luminary
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever another historic permanent you control with mana value 3 or greater enters, draw a card. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one other target creature and two charge counters on up to one target Spacecraft.

cards.name: Worf, Defiant Commander
cards.oracle_text:
When Worf enters, create a 2/1 red Klingon Warrior creature token with haste.
Battlefront — Whenever you attack, exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of opponents you attacked this turn. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.

cards.name: Ambassador K'Ehleyr
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Parley — At the beginning of combat on your turn, each player reveals the top card of their library, then draws a card. For each nonland card revealed this way, put a +1/+1 counter on Ambassador K'Ehleyr.

cards.name: Balance of Terror
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Destroy up to one other target artifact or enchantment.
II, III — Exile up to one other target permanent you control. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Beverly Crusher, Ship's Doctor
cards.oracle_text: Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to three target creatures.

cards.name: Borg Incursion
cards.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 colorless Borg artifact creature tokens, then artifact creatures you control gain protection from the color of your choice until end of turn. (They can't be blocked, targeted, dealt damage, enchanted, or equipped by anything of that color.)

cards.name: Dr. Pulaski, Cynical Clinician
cards.oracle_text: Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, you gain 4 life.

cards.name: Emergency Regeneration
cards.oracle_text: Artifacts you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
